assessment_mode.label: Assessment Mode
assessment_mode.meaning: Chooses whether we assess the option using today's housing setup or a Deferred Income Assessment scenario.
assessment_mode.calculation: Standard uses the loan details you enter. Deferred assumes a 75% bank loan, 25% downpayment, 2.60% interest, and a 25-year tenure.
assessment_mode.assumptions: Deferred planning is anchored to the assessment window before key collection.

purchase_price.label: Purchase Price
purchase_price.meaning: The full agreed flat or property price before grants.
purchase_price.calculation: Used to estimate buyer stamp duty and to derive net purchase price, downpayment, and loan sizing.
purchase_price.assumptions: Enter the best current estimate for the home price.

grant_amount.label: Grant Amount
grant_amount.meaning: The housing grant amount you expect to receive.
grant_amount.calculation: Subtracted from purchase price to get net purchase price before downpayment and loan calculations.
grant_amount.assumptions: Deferred mode ignores grants in this form's planning assumptions.

loan_amount.label: Loan Amount
loan_amount.meaning: The amount you plan to borrow for this option.
loan_amount.calculation: Used directly for mortgage repayment when provided. If it is left at zero in derived views, the system estimates it from net price minus downpayment.
loan_amount.assumptions: Loan amount should not exceed net purchase price.
loan_amount.source: User-provided or system-derived depending on the view.

interest_rate.label: Interest Rate
interest_rate.meaning: The annual loan interest rate used for repayment estimation.
interest_rate.calculation: Monthly mortgage is calculated from loan amount, interest rate, and tenure.
interest_rate.assumptions: HDB loans are fixed here at 2.60%.
interest_rate.source: User-provided except for HDB and Deferred defaults.

loan_tenure.label: Loan Tenure
loan_tenure.meaning: The total number of years used to spread the loan repayment.
loan_tenure.calculation: A longer tenure usually lowers the monthly mortgage but stretches repayment over a longer period.

buyer_stamp_duty.label: Buyer Stamp Duty
buyer_stamp_duty.meaning: An estimated BSD amount for the purchase price entered above.
buyer_stamp_duty.calculation: Calculated using the current progressive residential BSD tiers coded in the app.
buyer_stamp_duty.assumptions: This is an estimate for planning and does not include every possible tax variation.

monthly_maintenance.label: Monthly Maintenance
monthly_maintenance.meaning: The recurring monthly maintenance or conservancy cost for the home.
monthly_maintenance.calculation: Added on top of the monthly mortgage to produce monthly housing cost.
monthly_maintenance.assumptions: Use an estimate if the final fee is not confirmed yet.

legal_fees.label: Legal Fees
legal_fees.meaning: Expected legal and conveyancing costs for the purchase.
legal_fees.calculation: Added into upfront cost together with downpayment and stamp duty.
legal_fees.assumptions: This is a planning estimate unless you already have a confirmed quote.

expected_key_collection_date.label: Expected Key Collection Date
expected_key_collection_date.meaning: The target date when you expect to collect keys for the home.
expected_key_collection_date.calculation: Deferred planning uses this to anchor the assessment window before collection.
expected_key_collection_date.assumptions: The app treats the planning point as roughly six months before key collection.

dia_income_section.label: DIA Income Inputs
dia_income_section.meaning: Projected monthly incomes for each person at the Deferred Income Assessment window.
dia_income_section.calculation: These values feed the projected take-home used in affordability estimates for this housing option only.
dia_income_section.assumptions: Student, NSF, unemployed, and future employee statuses are treated as full-time employee when a future income is supplied.
dia_income_section.supporting_tip: Enter each member's estimated monthly income at the assessment window before key collection. This will update their projected income profile for this housing option.

dia_income_estimated_income.label: Estimated Monthly Income
dia_income_estimated_income.meaning: The expected gross monthly income for that person at the assessment period.
dia_income_estimated_income.calculation: Used to estimate projected household take-home after employee CPF deductions.
dia_income_estimated_income.assumptions: Leave it aligned with your best expected starting pay, not bonuses.

gross_income_used.label: Gross Income Used
gross_income_used.meaning: The household gross monthly income used for this scenario.
gross_income_used.calculation: Built from current incomes unless future income profiles or DIA overrides are present for this housing option.
gross_income_used.assumptions: This is scenario-based and can differ from today's dashboard income.
gross_income_used.source: System-derived from household profiles and housing-specific overrides.

take_home_used.label: Take-Home Used
take_home_used.meaning: The monthly take-home income used in the affordability calculation.
take_home_used.calculation: Derived from the scenario wages after estimated employee CPF deductions for each person.
take_home_used.assumptions: Projected income inputs can change this value for Deferred scenarios.

cpf_oa_used.label: CPF OA Used
cpf_oa_used.meaning: The current household CPF Ordinary Account balance available for planning.
cpf_oa_used.calculation: Used to offset part of the required downpayment before cash top-up is needed.
cpf_oa_used.assumptions: This uses the current CPF OA saved in member profiles.

cash_savings_used.label: Cash Savings Used
cash_savings_used.meaning: The current household cash savings available for planning.
cash_savings_used.calculation: Compared against the cash top-up required after CPF OA is applied to upfront costs.
cash_savings_used.assumptions: This uses the current cash balances saved in member profiles.

monthly_expenses_used.label: Monthly Expenses Used
monthly_expenses_used.meaning: The household monthly expenses already committed outside the housing payment.
monthly_expenses_used.calculation: Subtracted from take-home together with housing cost to estimate surplus after housing.
monthly_expenses_used.assumptions: This is based on the current expenses saved in member profiles.

upfront_cost.label: Upfront Cost
upfront_cost.meaning: The total cash-and-CPF amount needed upfront for this option.
upfront_cost.calculation: Downpayment + legal fees + buyer stamp duty + any renovation and furniture budgets tracked for the option.
upfront_cost.assumptions: Current housing form keeps renovation and furniture budgets at zero.

required_downpayment.label: Required Downpayment
required_downpayment.meaning: The upfront downpayment portion required before the loan starts.
required_downpayment.calculation: Calculated from net purchase price and the option's downpayment percentage.

estimated_loan_amount.label: Estimated Loan Amount
estimated_loan_amount.meaning: The loan value used in the affordability calculation.
estimated_loan_amount.calculation: Uses the entered loan amount when available, otherwise estimates net purchase price minus downpayment.
estimated_loan_amount.assumptions: Deferred mode derives this from the default 75% loan assumption.
estimated_loan_amount.source: User-provided or system-derived depending on scenario.

cpf_used.label: CPF Used
cpf_used.meaning: The CPF OA amount applied toward the required downpayment.
cpf_used.calculation: This is the smaller of available household CPF OA and the required downpayment.
cpf_used.assumptions: Only CPF OA is considered here.

cash_top_up_required.label: Cash Top-Up Required
cash_top_up_required.meaning: The cash still needed after CPF OA is used toward upfront cost.
cash_top_up_required.calculation: Upfront cost minus CPF used, floored at zero.
cash_top_up_required.assumptions: A positive value means CPF OA alone is not enough for upfront costs.

monthly_mortgage.label: Monthly Mortgage
monthly_mortgage.meaning: The estimated monthly loan repayment for this option.
monthly_mortgage.calculation: Computed from loan amount, interest rate, and loan tenure using a standard amortized repayment formula.
monthly_mortgage.assumptions: If interest is zero, repayment is spread evenly across the tenure.

monthly_housing_cost.label: Monthly Housing Cost
monthly_housing_cost.meaning: The recurring monthly housing burden used for affordability.

monthly_surplus_after_housing.label: Monthly Surplus After Housing
monthly_surplus_after_housing.meaning: What remains each month after expenses and housing costs.
monthly_surplus_after_housing.calculation: Take-home used - monthly expenses used - monthly housing cost.
monthly_surplus_after_housing.assumptions: A negative value signals the option is not affordable on current scenario assumptions.

rating.label: Affordability Rating
rating.meaning: A quick planning label for how heavy the housing option looks against take-home pay.
rating.calculation: The app compares monthly housing cost against take-home and also checks whether monthly surplus stays non-negative.
rating.assumptions: Higher housing-cost-to-income ratios move the rating from Comfortable toward Not Recommended.
